events.title: Police and protesters face off in Albania on third day of anti-govt demonstrations

events.title: 'We're done': Ukraine resumes strikes on Russian oil refineries as 'only leverage' for peace talks
events.description: Delano D'Souza is pleased to welcome Peter Zalmayev, Founder and Director of the Eurasia Democracy Initiative, LIVE from Kyiv. As Zelensky declares Ukraine "done" with Trump's self-declared energy ceasefire and resumes strikes on Russian oil refineries, Zalmayev warns: "When you talk about the energy ceasefire, it presupposes two to be able to tango and to dance this dance." He challenges the legitimacy of Trump's unilateral announcement, made without agreement between Moscow and Kyiv, as Russia continues attacking Ukraine's energy infrastructure. Yet he cautions that Zelensky may need tactical restraint to preserve vital US support. Zalmayev also examines Western sanctions, frozen Russian assets, and Washington's pursuit of economic normalization with Moscow without meaningful Russian concessions.

events.title: These workers help train robots who could one day steal their jobs

events.title: Resignation of Bärbel Bas shines light on harsh era of German politics

events.title: Germany news: Train station alcohol ban comes into force

events.title: Why have US-Ukraine relations soured ahead of the midterms?

With Trump under pressure over rising fuel prices, is the White House hoping criticism of Kyiv can help shift the blame?

events.title: Election delay 'a terrible disappointment', Palestinian activist Samer Sinijlawi says
events.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Palestinian activist Samer Sinijlawi called the postponement of the first legislative elections in 20 years to September 2027 "a terrible disappointment" for a generation that has never had a chance to vote. He also dismissed the citing of Israeli restrictions as an excuse, pointing instead to a "rejection" of change among ageing Palestinian leaders.

events.title: ‘Amazing progress’ in lung cancer: Immunotherapy extends survival as mRNA vaccines offer hope
events.description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Siow-Ming Lee, Professor of Medical Oncology at the University College London and a specialist in lung cancer. “Lung cancer is not one cancer. There are many different types of lung cancer,” explains Lee. For decades, lung cancer has been closely associated with smoking, late diagnosis and poor survival prospects. Yet there is a broader revolution in cancer brewing: Medicine advances in molecular oncology, minimally invasive surgery and immunotherapy are fundamentally transforming both the understanding and treatment of the disease, including among patients who have never smoked.

events.title: From Lupin's return to a bloody culinary apocalypse: The TV shows to watch this month
events.description: TV critic Dheepthika Laurent takes us through this month's TV highlights, starting with the long-awaited return of "Lupin", Netflix's most-watched French series.
